title: A bound for the nilpotence index associated to $m$-nil-clean nonderogatory matrices
summary: It is proved that if $\mathbb{F}$ is a field of positive characteristic $p,$ and if $m$ and $n$ are positive integers such that $m\geq2,$ and $4\leq n\leq p\leq mn-1,$ for every $n\times n$ nonderogatory matrix $A\in \mathbb{M}_n(\mathbb{F}),$ with trace in $\{k.1_{\mathbb{F}}\mid k\in \{0,1,\dots,p-1\}\},$ there exist $m$ idempotent matrices $E_1, E_2,\dots, E_m,$ and a nilpotent matrix $N$, such that $A=E_1+E_2+\dots+E_m+N,$ with $N^k=0,$ where $k=n$ if $p\in \{nm-1,nm-2\},$ $k=n-1$ if $p=nm-3,$ otherwise $k=\mathrm{max}(2,1+\lfloor\frac{n-1}{r}\rfloor),$ if $n$ is even, and…
